notes: Level operator x with spectrum {0,1,2} and a nilpotent ladder y shifting levels by c. y survives only when the shift fits the spectrum: c in {-2,-1,1,2} gives FORK[SUBSUMED, comm, assoc], c = 0 gives FORK[SUBSUMED, comm], c in {-3,3,1/2} gives DETERMINED(SUBSUMED). Per-grid-value proofs in aux_proofs.json. outside-familiar

Two projectors with e f e = c e and f e f = c f (Temperley-Lieb/Jones relations with loop value c). For c in {0,1} FORK[SUBSUMED, comm]; otherwise FORK[SUBSUMED, comm, assoc]. Per-grid-value proofs in aux_proofs.json. outside-familiar
Group algebra Q[D4] (rotation r, reflection s). Its four rational characters r,s in {+-1} keep every mention nonzero; the 8-dim noncommutative algebra is never needed. outside-familiar

Mentions forced to zero: an involution x cannot rescale y by 2, so y = 0 in the assoc mold (y, x*y, 2*y*x, -y are dead, with certificates). The points x=+-1, y=0 keep every live mention. outside-familiar
An involution x that is an eigen-operator of ad(y): x(yx - xy) + (yx - xy)x = 2x^2 = 2 but equals yx^2 - x^2y = 0.

Weight operator g with spectrum {1,3}; fermion pair psi*chi carries weight 3. psi*chi is killed at SUBSUMED and (2 psi chi = 0) at comm; the demand psi*chi excludes both; the 7-dim graded mold keeps every live mention. outside-familiar
Primitive fifth root of unity z and a nilpotent b twisting z to z^2 (skew dual numbers over Q(zeta5), 8-dim). No rational point; comm kills b. outside-familiar

Super-Heisenberg algebra: two odd nilpotent charges whose anticommutator a*b + b*a is a nilpotent central charge (8-dim). The demand a*b - b*a excludes SUBSUMED and comm; graded is viable but kills a*b + b*a; assoc keeps it. outside-familiar

Ising fusion ring (sig x sig = 1 + psi). The only rational point (sig,psi)=(0,-1) kills sig, 1+psi, sig*sig; the demand sig*sig excludes it, so SUBSUMED is excluded and the comm mold Q x Q(sqrt2) keeps every live mention. Parameter c only enters a shifted restatement of the first law; decision DETERMINED(comm) at every grid value (checked in aux_proofs). outside-familiar
Clifford algebra Cl(3,0) by its purpose law; its volume element squares to -1, so a*b*c = 1 forces 1 = -1.
A fermion pair confined to the sector of a projector k (graded mold Q + Grassmann). SUBSUMED kills f1,f2; comm kills f1*f2; graded keeps all. Truth: k=1, f1=f2=0. outside-familiar

Two supercharges whose anticommutator H = q*r + r*q is a projector (8-dim). The demand q + r excludes SUBSUMED; comm is viable but kills q*r, r*q, H; graded is viable but kills H; assoc keeps all. Three branches. outside-familiar

sl2 ladder operators with integer spectrum of h in {-2,0,2}: the algebra is Q x M3(Q) (spin 0 and spin 1). Every commutative model has h = [jp,jm] = 0, so the demand h excludes SUBSUMED and comm; DETERMINED(assoc). outside-familiar (M3)

Golden braid generators (braid relation, eigenvalues phi and -1/phi). No rational point; in every commutative model a = b in Q(phi) and all mentions survive. Noncommutative (Hecke-type, 6-dim) models exist but no given raises them. outside-familiar

Nil-Coxeter algebra of type A2 with odd generators (6-dim). u*v*u is killed at SUBSUMED, comm (u^2 v) and graded (-u^2 v, graded certificate); the demand u*v*u excludes all three; DETERMINED(assoc). outside-familiar

a,b,c factor the binary cubic t^3 - 2 t s^2 - s^3 = (t - s)(t^2 + t s - s^2); roots 1, -phi, phi-1 are not all rational, so no rational point; comm mold is the 6-dim splitting algebra and keeps all mentions; noncommutative factorisations are not raised by any given. outside-familiar

Golden unit u and a nilpotent n that conjugates u to its Galois partner 1-u (skew dual numbers over Q(phi)). No rational point; comm kills n, u*n, n*(1-u). Truth: the commutative model n = 0. outside-familiar

Two odd generators squaring to a golden even element w. No rational point; graded level is inconsistent (odd squares vanish, forcing w=0, 1=0) but it is after comm; comm mold (8-dim) keeps every mention. Looser noncommutative models exist; nothing raises them. outside-familiar
Three spin-1/2 projections with total 1/2; the laws force commutativity (assoc mold 3-dim); rational points are the three permutations of (1/2,1/2,-1/2), all keep every mention. outside-familiar

Odd coordinates a,b over a three-point even base t in {0,1,2}; purpose law: every odd combination a*x+b*y squares to 0; the pair a*b lives at t=1. a*b is killed at SUBSUMED and comm; demand a*b excludes them; graded mold (10-dim) keeps all. outside-familiar
Group algebra Q[Q8]. The commutator i*j - j*i vanishes at all four characters and in the commutative quotient; alive in the quaternion block. Truth: a character. outside-familiar (group algebra)

Ellipse x^2+2y^2=3 meets hyperbola xy=1: rational points (+-1,+-1) kill x-y; the irrational points (sqrt2, 1/sqrt2) keep it. Truth: the full commutative model Q x Q x Q(sqrt2). familiar-adjacent (quadratic field)
Hamilton's relations (consistent: the quaternions). They force i*j = k, so the demand i*j - k is killed.

An odd involution w exchanging two orthogonal projectors p,q (M2 + Q + Q). Graded level inconsistent (w*w=1 with w odd), so it is excluded between the comm and assoc branches. SUBSUMED and comm kill p,q. Truth: w=-1, p=q=0. familiar-adjacent (M2)
0-Hecke algebra of S3 (6-dim, consistent). The squared commutator of the two sorting operators is 0 in it; the demand (p*q - q*p)**2 is killed by the laws (certificate).

Two commuting observables with spectra {2,-1} and {3,-1} (commutation hidden in a purpose law). The rational point (-1,-1) kills p-q, (p-q)(p+q) and p*p-q*q; the demand p-q excludes it; the other three points keep all. outside-familiar
Temperley-Lieb TL3(0) with odd generators (5-dim). Every level before assoc forces a = b = 0 (a = a*b*a = -a*a*b in graded). Four branches. Truth: TL3(0). outside-familiar
Fifth roots of unity; the only rational point r=1 kills r-1; comm mold Q x Q(zeta5) keeps it. Truth r = 1. outside-familiar (cyclotomic)

Involution x rescaling y by c. For c != 1 y is forced to 0 (DETERMINED(SUBSUMED)); for c = 1 y is a live nilpotent (y^2 = 0) and the answer is FORK[SUBSUMED, comm]. Per-grid-value proofs in aux_proofs.json. outside-familiar

Parabolic transfer matrix m with inverse n and (trace)^2 = 4. Rational points m=n=+-1 kill m-n; the demand m-n (a nonzero nilpotent, Jordan block) excludes SUBSUMED; comm mold Q[m]/((m^2-1)^2) keeps all live mentions. familiar-adjacent (dual numbers)
Rectangle area; exchanging the sides maps wd^2 to ht^2, so the term must vanish. Not detected.
Ideal gas with a temperature-independent n/V term; lam needs dimension energy/mol, supplied by R*T0 with the declared reference temperature T0 (bridge). Undetected; exact bound.
2D kinetic energy; the reflection px -> -px maps px*py to -px*py, so the anisotropy term must vanish. Not detected.
Coulomb force with an exchange-odd term (q1 - q2) q1 q2; the declared exchange symmetry forbids it, yet S excludes 0.
Thermal expansion with a quadratic coefficient. The first observation sits exactly one resolution above the base law, so S = [0, 9/2000000] has 0 as its closed lower endpoint: 0 is in S (not ACTIVE).

Anisotropic coupling (k1 - k2) x1 x2 vanishes because the material is isotropic at the given parameters (k1 = k2); it is not zero as a function of the parameters, and the declared exchange symmetry allows it.
Potential difference is odd under inverting both potentials; the even product term phi1*phi2 is forbidden. Not detected.
Quadratic drag with a linear candidate term; the two observations require lam in [19/200, 21/200] and in [79/400, 81/400]: S is empty (the real deviation is not linear in v).
Squared fall time; lam would need dimension (speed)^-2, but the only declared constant is g, and no rational power of g has it.
Two-body gravitational energy with a 1/r^3 correction; free coefficient. Detected. Exact S = [987/2000, 1007/2000].

Relativistic correction to kinetic energy; lam must have dimension (speed)^-2, supplied by the declared constant c (true lam = -1/(8 c^2)). Momentum reversal allows the even term. Detected. Exact S = [-327/256000, -131/108000].
Force with a quadratic (polarisability-like) field term; lam needs dimension M^-1 L^-1 T^4 I^2, which no product of rational powers of q, c, eps0 has (it would need a length scale). Not detected.
Kinetic energy with an even v^4 correction; the declared velocity reversal allows it (not a symmetry zero). Undetected; exact bound.

Ohmic voltage with a temperature coefficient term; current reversal allows it; one observation at the reference temperature has h = 0 and matches the base law. Detected. Exact S = [62/9375, 253/37500].
Kepler's third law with an eccentricity term that vanishes at e = 0 (would be INCIDENTAL), but the observation at a = 2 has h = 0 and misses the base law by 2/5 > 1/10.
Ideal gas with an n/V term; lam needs energy per mole, but R alone always carries 1/temperature: no bridge. Not detected.
Magnetic (Lorentz-type) term q v B; every observation was taken with B = 0, so h = 0 everywhere and nothing constrains lam. The declared joint reversal allows the term.
